# Growable_Memory_RNN

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-18

## Definition
An RNN architecture whose internal memory capacity can expand incrementally as new temporal information is encountered. Provides adaptive temporal memory for iNEST systems that must handle non-stationary data streams without fixed-size memory limits.
